title: Black-framed glass sliding doors
summary: Black-framed glass sliding doors, hung from new timber fixed into the ceiling.
intro: Black-framed glass doors that slide to close off a room without losing the light. The track needed something solid to hang from, so I opened the ceiling along the line of the doors, fixed timber between the joists and closed it up again before the doors went in.
